notes: Composio supports managed OAuth out of the box for quick testing without custom credentials.
When using custom credentials, ensure all required scopes (`chat:write`, `channels:read`, etc.) are pre-configured in your Slack app settings.
Composio handles token encryption and retention securely in compliance with standard policies.

assumption: An AI agent that reads channels and sends messages in any customer's Slack workspace

verdict.headline: Slack offers instant self-serve registration for testing, but public commercial distribution requires a Marketplace review taking up to 10 weeks.
verdict.summary: You can create a Slack app instantly at api.slack.com and connect your own workspace in minutes using unlisted public distribution. However, if you want to deploy to arbitrary public users without Slack Marketplace warnings, you must pass a preliminary review (up to 10 business days) and a functional review (up to 10 weeks).

handsOnEffort.label: 2–4 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Configuring app credentials, scope permissions, and callback URLs in the Slack API console.

timeToFirstConnection.label: 15–30 min
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Self-serve app creation and immediate workspace installation.

timeToProduction.label: 2–12 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Slack states preliminary review takes 10 business days and functional review takes up to 10 weeks.

verdict.longestPole: Slack Marketplace security and functional review timelines
verdict.costDetail: Slack app creation and API usage are free of charge.

easierPaths.condition: Internal-only workspace usage or unlisted distribution
easierPaths.effect: Bypasses the Slack Marketplace review entirely.

factors.detail: Developers can create apps instantly at api.slack.com/apps without human intervention.
Public commercial distribution requires submission to the Slack Marketplace for review.
Marketplace listing and certain restricted scopes require developer business identity verification.
Marketplace submission includes a functional and security review of app behavior and permissions.
Slack does not charge fees for developer app registration or API access.
No sales contact or partner program is required to register or distribute a standard Slack app.
Unlisted public distribution allows installation across multiple workspaces without a hard user cap, though individual workspaces may block unlisted apps.
Users authorize the app via standard OAuth redirect without manual token provisioning.

phases.title: Register App
phases.outcome: A Slack application shell with credentials and redirect URI configured.

steps.title: Create the Slack App
steps.details: Go to **Slack API Apps** (`https://api.slack.com/apps`), click **Create New App**, choose **From scratch**, enter an App Name, and select your development workspace.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Redirect URL
steps.details: Navigate to **OAuth & Permissions** in the sidebar. Under **Redirect URLs**, click **Add New Redirect URL** and enter `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`. Click **Save URLs**.
steps.agentAssist: Draft the exact redirect URI string for the developer to paste.

steps.title: Configure Scopes
steps.details: Scroll down to **Scopes** under **OAuth & Permissions**. Under **Bot Token Scopes**, add `chat:write`, `channels:read`, `channels:history`, and `search:read` as required by your agent tools.
steps.agentAssist: Provide a complete list of recommended bot and user scopes based on your agent tools.

phases.title: Test Locally with Own Account
phases.outcome: Verified OAuth flow and bot message posting in your test workspace.

steps.title: Install App to Workspace
steps.details: Scroll to the top of the **OAuth & Permissions** page and click **Install to Workspace**. Review the requested permissions and click **Allow**.

steps.title: Retrieve Client ID and Client Secret
steps.details: Navigate to **Basic Information** in the sidebar. Under **App Credentials**, copy your `Client ID` and `Client Secret`. Keep these secure.

phases.title: Prepare for Distribution (Optional for Public Users)
phases.outcome: Public distribution enabled or app packaged for Marketplace submission.

steps.title: Enable Public Distribution
steps.details: Go to **Manage Distribution** in the sidebar. Click **Activate Public Distribution** and complete any required checklist items to allow external workspace installations.
steps.agentAssist: Audit required checklist fields for public distribution readiness.

phases.title: Review and Wait
phases.outcome: Slack Marketplace approval for public listing, if commercial distribution is required.

steps.title: Slack Marketplace Review
steps.details: Submit your app for review via the **Manage Distribution** tab. Slack performs a preliminary review (up to 10 business days) followed by a functional review (up to 10 weeks).
steps.agentAssist: Draft privacy policy text, terms of service URLs, and scope usage justifications.

phases.title: Go Live in Composio
phases.outcome: Custom Slack OAuth credentials integrated into Composio for automated AI agent execution.

steps.title: Create Custom Auth Config in Composio
steps.details: In your Composio dashboard, navigate to **Custom Auth** or **Integrations**, select **Slack**, and create a new custom integration configuration.
steps.agentAssist: Use Composio API to provision the custom auth configuration programmatically.

steps.title: Enter Slack Credentials
steps.details: Paste your Slack app's `Client ID` and `Client Secret` into the Composio configuration fields. Save the configuration to generate your custom integration auth ID.

requirements.detail: Required to access api.slack.com/apps and create application credentials.

requirements.item: App Manifest or Manual Scope Configuration
requirements.detail: Configure bot and user scopes like `chat:write`, `channels:read`, and `search:read` in the app configuration.

blockers.title: This app isn't listed in the Slack Marketplace
blockers.symptom: Users attempting to install an unlisted public app encounter an error or warning page.
blockers.howToProceed: Disable 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' in the workspace app management settings under `Settings → Apps & Workflows → App Management Settings`.

blockers.title: Workspace Requires Admin/Owner Approval
blockers.symptom: Users are prompted to submit an approval request during authorization instead of completing the install.
blockers.howToProceed: An administrator must approve the app in the workspace's App Management Settings or disable 'Require approved apps'.

nuances.title: Token Lifetimes
nuances.detail: Slack standard bot tokens do not expire by default unless Token Rotation is explicitly enabled in app settings (which sets access tokens to expire in 12 hours).

nuances.title: OAuth v2 Exchange Endpoint
nuances.detail: Slack uses `https://slack.com/api/oauth.v2.access` with a 10-minute temporary authorization code window.

steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard and open the Slack toolkit configuration.
Select custom credentials and enter your Slack Client ID and Client Secret.
Ensure the redirect URI `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` is registered in your Slack app console.
Pass the resulting custom auth config ID when initiating agent execution sessions.
